Relief shown by hachures, contours, and spot heights. Title from index sheet. Each sheet individually titled and numbered, for example "Gyimes-Pasz, zone 19 kol. XXXIV". Includes various editions of most sheets. Later sheets produced by Kartographisches Institut and the Bundesamt für Eich- und Vermessungswesen. Hungarian text on some sheets.
